name: Bidkar
bio: Bidkar was Jehu's captain. After Jehu killed Jehoram (Joram), king of Israel, he told Bidkar to throw the body into the field that had belonged to Naboth the Jezreelite, recalling that the two of them had ridden together behind Ahab when the LORD pronounced judgment on him for Naboth's murder (2 Kings 9:25-26).
